title: Friday lower body and glutes
subtitle: ~30 min · at home · after work
feeling: Ran yesterday, so keeping today moderate. Legs and glutes, no upper body.
note: Moderate effort, about 6 out of 10, and stop each set with 2 to 3 reps left. If your hamstring feels tight, go slow on the deadlifts or swap them for extra glute bridges. Nice work getting this in at the end of the week.

items.name: March in place, leg swings, hip circles
items.cue: Easy pace. Swing each leg front to back and side to side to loosen your hips and hamstrings.

sections.label: 2 · Circuit · 3 rounds
sections.instructions: Do all 4 moves in a row with no rest between them. Rest 30 seconds after the last move. Repeat 3 times.

items.name: Bulgarian split squat
items.cue: Back foot on a couch or chair. Bodyweight is fine, or hold a 10-15 lb dumbbell in each hand. Lower straight down with your front knee over your toes.

items.name: Romanian deadlift
items.cue: A 20 lb dumbbell in each hand. Soft knees, push your hips back, and slide the weights down your legs. Stop when you feel a stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.

items.name: Glute bridge
items.cue: On your back, knees bent, feet flat. Press through your heels to lift your hips. Squeeze at the top for a second.

items.name: Banded lateral walk
items.cue: Band just above your knees. Sit into a slight squat and step sideways, keeping tension on the band.

sections.label: 3 · Core · 2 rounds
sections.instructions: Do both moves in a row on the mat. Rest 20 seconds. Repeat 2 times.

items.name: Dead bug
items.cue: On your back, arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor. Keep your lower back pressed down.

items.name: Reverse crunch
items.cue: Lie on your back. Bring your knees to your chest and lift your hips a little. Lower slowly.

items.name: Hamstring, hip and glute stretch
items.cue: Sit with your legs out and reach gently toward your toes. Then a figure-four stretch for each glute. Breathe slowly.
